documents.title: Supporting evidence
documents.text:
I have worked for 3 years in a care home in Leeds, starting in October 2023. I knock on the door before entering. I explain what I will do before personal hygiene. I always close the curtains. I respect each person's culture and religion. I ask what the person wants to eat. I ask how the person wants to be treated. I ask whether the person prefers to be helped by a woman.

I saw a bruise on a resident's arm. I recorded it and told the nurse on duty straight away. She made the safeguarding report. In the dementia unit, residents became agitated at the end of the day, so we, the whole team, moved dinner earlier. I made cards with photographs of food so each person could point to what they want to eat.

I have moving and handling training and use a hoist. We always work in pairs. I have medication training and do the morning medication round for 18 residents. Before the shift, I read each resident's care plan and do what is in it. At the end of the shift, I write the daily notes in English and sign the medication sheet. I did two years of night shifts, and in the last year I moved to doing days.

documents.title: Cover letter
documents.text:
Dear North Yorkshire Council hiring team,

I am applying for the Care and Support Worker role at North Yorkshire Council.

I have worked for 3 years in a care home in Leeds, starting in October 2023. Before the shift, I read each resident's care plan and do what is in it. I have medication training and do the morning medication round for 18 residents. At the end of the shift, I write the daily notes in English and sign the medication sheet.

I have moving and handling training and use a hoist. We always work in pairs. In the dementia unit, residents became agitated at the end of the day, so we, the whole team, moved dinner earlier. I made cards with photographs of food so each person could point to what they want to eat.

I did two years of night shifts, and in the last year I moved to doing days. I saw a bruise on a resident's arm. I recorded it and told the nurse on duty straight away. She made the safeguarding report.

Thank you for considering my application.

Yours sincerely, Ana
